root_cause: The modal's click handler treats any click on an element with the data-micromodal-close attribute as a close action, including clicks that bubble up from inner controls (e.g., checkboxes) to the overlay, causing the modal to close unexpectedly when interacting with those controls.
repair_strategy: Update the onClick handler to close the modal only when the click target itself has the close-trigger attribute, and to stop propagation of clicks originating inside the modal container that lack the close-trigger attribute, preventing them from reaching the overlay.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on a checkbox inside the modal will toggle the checkbox without closing the modal, keeping the dialog open and focus managed within it, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard operability and 2.4.3 focus order.
functional_risks: Potential interference with custom click handlers that rely on event bubbling from internal modal elements.
Incorrectly stopping propagation could hinder other functionality if developers depend on the bubbling behavior of clicks inside the modal.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Space on a checkbox toggles its state and the modal remains open (aria-hidden false).
Confirm that clicking the overlay or close button still closes the modal as expected.
Ensure focus returns to the trigger element when the modal is closed via overlay or close button.
Check that regression guards (e.g., Done closes dialog from keyboard) continue to pass.
Ensure no adverse effects on other modal instances or usage patterns.
